svg.title: IOITF showcase report preview
svg.desc: Measured arm64 development report: 254 cases and 2,032 paired fixture trials match, while 1,516 independent direct oracle checks detect 171 Python model output mismatches: 36 under official nearest-even contracts and 135 under explicitly validated rounding extensions. Other assertion failures and execution errors are zero. These findings bypass the comparator and are not OpenPOWER native evidence.

g.text: Paired fixtures agree. Independent checks detect NaN and rounding errors.
Python model output differs from fixed SSE2 reference bits.
QUALITY CHECK FAILED // MODEL OUTPUT MISMATCH
INDEPENDENT MODEL ORACLE // EXPANDED BUG HUNT
Python model output differs from SSE2 expected bits
OFFICIAL NEAREST-EVEN: 36 / VALIDATED ROUNDING EXTENSIONS: 135 NEW
1,516 direct output checks bypass ioitf.compare. Official case contracts remain unchanged.
Rounding ignored: arithmetic 56 · sqrt 8 · float → integer 37
Rounding ignored: f64 → f32 16 · integer → float 18
Counts are failing input patterns, not distinct bugs. Rounding failures share one cause across five paths.
Example: f32 sqrt(2), toward_positive → expected 0x3fb504f4 / model 0x3fb504f3
C SANITIZERS: PASS CROSS BUILD: PASS REGRESSION TEST METHODS: 127 EXECUTED
504 SSE2 reference rows checked under Rosetta with strict FP at -O0 and -O2. No OpenPOWER hardware finding.
Source: expanded-model-oracle-report/quality/summary.json. These findings do not prove the whole framework bug-free.
Eight vectors per case. Paired agreement does not establish model correctness; independent findings are shown above.
MEASURED SNAPSHOT // expanded-model-oracle-report // ARM64 DARWIN // PYTHON 3.14.7 // NOT NATIVE EVIDENCE
